examples.arabic: بس هالمرة، قرر يعطيها هدية غير تقليدية بمناسبة عيد جوازهم الخامس والعشرين.
examples.english: But this time, he decided to give her an unconventional gift for their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary.
examples.transliteration: Bas hal-marra, qarrar ya'teeha hadiyye ghayr taqleediyye bimunaasabet 'eed jawaazhom il-khaames w-il-'ishreen.

examples.arabic: العاصفة كانت أقوى من أي عاصفة رأوها في سنواتهم العشرين الماضية، والمطر كان غزيراً جداً، حتى سدت المصارف.
examples.english: The storm was stronger than any storm they had seen in their past twenty years, and the rain was so heavy that it clogged the drains.
examples.transliteration: Al-'aasifeh kanat aqwa min ayy 'aasifeh ra'aw-ha fi sanawat-hum al-'ishreen al-madiya, wal-matar kan ghazeeran jiddan, hatta saddat al-masaref.

examples.arabic: عمري عشرين سنة وانا ضايع بالسوق
examples.english: I am twenty years old and I am lost in the market.
examples.transliteration: omri ishreen sane w ana daye bil souq

examples.arabic: طارق، طالب عمرو عشرين سنة ودايماً متوتر، بدو منقوشة، بس معو بس خمسين ألف ليرة بجيبتو.
examples.english: Tariq, a student whose age is twenty years and is always nervous, wants a man'oushe, but he has only fifty thousand liras in his pocket.
examples.transliteration: Tariq, taleb omro ishrin sana wa dayman mutawattir, biddo manoushe, bas mao bas khamsin alef lira bi jibto.

examples.arabic: ريحة مناقيش الزعتر السخنة ملت شارع الحمرا الصبح، ورامي، طالب جامعة عمرو عشرين سنة ودائماً مستعجل، كان كتير جوعان.
examples.english: The smell of hot zaatar manakish filled Hamra Street in the morning, and Rami, a twenty-year-old university student who is always in a hurry, was very hungry.
examples.transliteration: rihet manaqeesh el-zaatar el-sukhneh malet shareh el-hamra el-soboh, w-rami, taleb jameah omro ishrin sneh w-daiman mistaajel, kan keteer juaan.

examples.arabic: حكى معي انه عم يدرس وعمره عشرين سنة هلا
examples.english: He told me he's studying and he is twenty years old now.
examples.transliteration: ḥaka maʿī innuh ʿam yidrus w ʿumruh ʿishreen sane hallā'
